blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO. Agusan del Sur— The Department of Education (DepEd) in the Caraga Region has suspended the printing, distribution, and wearing of regional branding T-shirts featuring the traditional Manobo suyam embroidery after it drew flak from the Indigenous community for apparent cultural misappropriation.
